passages.original: Audite aliud sacramentum, fratres carissimi. beatus Hieronymus presbyter scripsit ab antiquis et senioribus Iudaeis se certissime agnouisse, quod ibi oblatus sit Isaac, ubi postea Christus crucifixus est. (denique ab eo loco, unde beatus Abraham iussus est proficisci, tertio die ad locum, ubi Christus crucifixus est), peruenitur.
passages.english: Hear another mystery, dearest brothers. The blessed priest Jerome wrote that he had learned with complete certainty from ancient and elderly Jews that Isaac was offered in the place where Christ was later crucified. And indeed, from the place from which blessed Abraham was ordered to set out, one arrives on the third day at the place where Christ was crucified.
passages.notes: "Sacramentum" is rendered "mystery" in the patristic sense of a hidden sign or figure. The parenthesis in the edition encloses most of the last sentence, leaving "peruenitur" outside it. This looks like an editorial or scanning irregularity, and the sentence has been translated as one continuous clause.
